answers.answer: Matches Unsloth's 3-bit figure (128 GB): UD-IQ3_XXS (120.4 GB) (after raising the Mac's GPU wired-memory limit)
answers.conditions: Unsloth's total-memory table (RAM + VRAM, or unified memory) for its GGUF files with llama.cpp; it does not say at what context length, and which file of a bit width fits at 128 GB is our reading. This setup counts 128 GB of unified memory. Unsloth says 3-bit works on 128 GB devices like a Mac or DGX Spark; the 120.4 GB file leaves little room for the OS and context, and no run or speed is published. Image input adds the 1.2 GB vision file. Use Unsloth's llama.cpp branch (glm5next/upstream) or Unsloth Desktop, as Unsloth's guide says. No published speed for this hardware. On a Mac, raise the GPU wired-memory limit first.
